market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $40,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Bitcoin near $76,500 on May 1; would need ~48% drawdown to touch $40k by Dec 31 2026. Drawdowns of that magnitude in an 8-month window are historically rare without a recession-grade macro event; conditional on the current Iran conflict, modest tail probability ~8-12%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro shock escalates into broad risk-asset capitulation
